mechanism: Phenobarbital induces CYP450 enzymes (particularly CYP3A4 and CYP2C19), increasing tranylcypromine metabolism and reducing MAOI efficacy, while both drugs cause CNS depression and phenobarbital may enhance tranylcypromine's hypertensive and serotonergic effects unpredictably.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor blood pressure closely and adjust tranylcypromine dosing due to altered pharmacokinetics, and counsel on additive CNS depression risks.
